summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of HistGradientBoostingClassifier not working with string targets when early stopping is enabled. It includes a new test file to reproduce the error and another to cover edge cases.

issues.description: The patch introduces new test files, which is consistent with the project's testing practices.
The code change is straightforward and easy to follow, but could benefit from additional comments explaining the purpose of converting integer-encoded labels back to original string labels.
